annotations.title: Creator posts available for Meta partnership ads

description: Posts this brand can run as PARTNERSHIP ADS: the content of Meta's Partnership Ads Hub (Meta's Partnership Ads Content Discovery API, on the brand's business). Browse with filters (creatorUsername or creatorIgUserIds, platforms INSTAGRAM / FACEBOOK, mediaTypes, postTypes FEED / STORY / REEL, contentTypes such as BRANDED_CONTENT or COLLAB_POST, adEligibilities AD_READY / NEEDS_ATTENTION / INELIGIBLE, adUsages NEVER_USED / ACTIVE / PREVIOUSLY_USED, countryCodes, startDate + endDate, search over captions, sortBy RECOMMENDED or DATE, recommendedOnly), or look posts up directly by ONE of postUrl / postUrls, adCodes or contentIds (up to 50). Each post comes back with its link, author, whether it is ad-ready and why not, the creator's permission status and its partnership ad code. Build the ad with create_meta_ad partnershipAdCode. When Meta refuses the read, the reply says it is Meta's access gate, not a connection problem. Read-only, free.

adCodes.description: partnership ad codes, up to 50 (direct lookup)

businessId.description: the business portfolio, when the Page's own cannot be read

contentIds.description: Instagram media or Facebook post ids, up to 50 (direct lookup)

contentTypes.description: BRANDED_CONTENT, PRODUCT, AFFILIATE, COLLAB_POST, TAGGED, REPOSTED

creatorUsername.description: a creator's Instagram handle (business or creator account)

pageId.description: the Page whose Instagram account runs the ads, when the brand has several

postUrl.description: one Instagram or Facebook post link (direct lookup)

postUrls.description: several post links, up to 50 (direct lookup)
